sources: live learning_objective and activity, band K2
note: config key curriculum.subjects is not in the live config table nor on main, so subject names below are the syllabus's own, with the brief's codes where one obviously fits.

rows.label: BOB
rows.reason: 7 of 11 BOB LOs are experiments or observations (melting, rain gauge, pinhole camera); the three non-science items (0389, 0604, 0407) are kept with it. Assumption: BOB's expansion is not given in the sources.

rows.label: PLS
rows.target: I & D character area: Practical Life skills (daily routine skills)
rows.reason: Syllabus puts Practical Life skills under Independence and Discipline; topics match (bag, caps and lids, handwashing). The four LOs filed under PLS that are really number/story/matching (M0083-M0085) follow their own content after rewrite.

rows.label: I & D
rows.target: Independence and Discipline (units FMS, GMS, PLS)
rows.reason: Named in the syllabus as a character strand; 122 LOs split FMS 39, GMS 33, PLS 50.

rows.label: VE
rows.target: Courage (Brave Day Task); feelings/calming-jar LOs go to Empathy & Happiness
rows.reason: VE activities match the Courage Brave Day list word for word; feelings LOs (0471-0475, 0615) read as Empathy & Happiness. Assumption: VE's expansion is not given in the sources.

rows.label: Block Room
rows.target: NUM (early numeracy and space: Block & Building, listed beside Numeracy under Critical Thinking)
rows.reason: Syllabus lists Block & Building beside Numeracy; LOs name sorting, grading by size and counting-type work with Montessori/Froebel blocks, so early numeracy and space is the default. Assumption: the smell LO (M0009) is a sense-training item and stays here as sensorial work.

rows.label: Dance
rows.reason: 19 LOs sit under Creativity/Dance; activity purposes say 'rhythm through music and dance' and the syllabus has Music & Rhythm but no Dance row, so Dance is movement to music inside Music.

rows.label: Montessori Hr
rows.reason: Checked live: 'Montessori Hr' appears only in band N (58 activities: Pink Tower, Beading, Brown Stairs). K2 has no activities or LOs with this label. In the K2 syllabus 'Montessori' is an approach used in art and block material, not a subject. Assumption (low confidence): nothing to place for K2; decision left to the band that uses this label and editable later.

rows.label: Sensory
rows.reason: Checked live: 'Sensory' appears only in band PG (17 activities, Introduction to Touch). Nothing in K2. In K2 sensory work appears inside BOB and Block Room LOs (0390, M0009). Assumption (low confidence): nothing to place for K2; decision left to the band that uses this label and editable later.

rows.label: Sensomotoric
rows.reason: Checked live: 'Sensomotoric' appears only in band PG (16 activities, e.g. Feely square, In & out). Nothing in K2. Assumption (low confidence): nothing to place for K2; decision left to the band that uses this label and editable later.

rows.label: (blank strand)
rows.target: ENG (Communication, Language & Literacy - English: alphabet writing)
rows.reason: The one K2 activity with a blank strand, ACT-K2-0497 'Writing A-Z, a-z / Flash cards (big words)', matches the syllabus English topic 'Pattern writing, small and capital letters (A-Z)' and 'Alphabet Writing'. Its two LOs are filed under Expression.
